aiNotes.A1: Mexico 2–0 South Africa is the most likely scoreline because Mexico’s home pressure, better attacking depth and stronger bench should eventually break South Africa’s compact block.
aiNotes.A2: South Korea 1–1 Czechia is the most realistic scoreline because Korea have the sharper transition weapons, while Czechia have enough aerial and set-piece threat to answer.
aiNotes.B1: Canada 2–1 Bosnia & Herzegovina is the most sensible prediction because Canada’s home pressure and transition speed should produce enough chances, but Bosnia’s direct football and set-piece threat make a clean home win unlikely.
aiNotes.D1: United States 2–1 Paraguay is the most realistic scoreline because USA have more attacking routes and home momentum, while Paraguay’s structure and transition threat keep the game close.
aiNotes.B2: Qatar 0–2 Switzerland is the most sensible prediction because Switzerland have the stronger midfield control, defensive stability and chance-creation structure, while Qatar’s attacking path depends too heavily on isolated transition moments.
aiNotes.C1: Brazil 2–1 Morocco is the most sensible prediction because Brazil have more match-winning attacking quality and bench depth, but Morocco’s compact block and transition threat make a clean or comfortable Brazil win unlikely.
aiNotes.C2: Haiti 1–2 Scotland is the most sensible prediction because Scotland have the stronger structure, set-piece threat and late-game options, but Haiti’s transition pace makes a clean win unlikely.
aiNotes.D2: Australia 1–2 Türkiye is the most sensible prediction because Türkiye have more creative quality and stronger recent form, while Australia’s defensive discipline and aerial threat make a narrow result more realistic than a comfortable win.
aiNotes.E1: Germany 3–0 Curaçao is the most sensible prediction because Germany have too many creative routes and bench options, while Curaçao’s attacking path depends on rare transition breaks.
aiNotes.F1: Netherlands 2–1 Japan is the most sensible prediction because the Dutch have more aerial power and late-game options, but Japan’s form, discipline and transition threat make a clean win unlikely.
aiNotes.E2: Ivory Coast 1–1 Ecuador is the most sensible prediction because Ivory Coast have the attacking speed to score, but Ecuador’s defensive structure and Caicedo-led midfield make them difficult to beat.
aiNotes.F2: Tunisia 0–2 Sweden is the most sensible prediction because Sweden have much more reliable scoring routes, while Tunisia’s recent defensive warning signs make a clean-sheet upset difficult.
aiNotes.H1: Spain 3–0 Cape Verde is the most sensible prediction because Spain’s possession, technical quality and bench depth should overwhelm Cape Verde’s compact block over 90 minutes.
aiNotes.G1: Belgium 2–1 Egypt is the most sensible prediction because Belgium have more creative routes and stronger bench options, but Egypt’s elite transition pair makes a clean Belgian win unlikely.
aiNotes.H2: Saudi Arabia 0–2 Uruguay is the most sensible prediction because Uruguay have the stronger midfield, pressing game and attacking depth, while Saudi Arabia’s best route depends on rare transition moments.
aiNotes.G2: Iran 2–0 New Zealand is the most sensible prediction because Iran have the stronger defensive structure and more reliable attacking route through Taremi, while New Zealand’s recent defensive form makes a clean result hard to trust.
aiNotes.I1: France 2–1 Senegal is the most sensible prediction because France have more creative depth and late-game solutions, but Senegal’s speed, physicality and transition threat make a clean win unlikely.
aiNotes.I2: Iraq 1–3 Norway is the most sensible prediction because Norway have far more reliable attacking routes, while Iraq’s best chance is a set-piece or isolated transition rather than sustained pressure.
aiNotes.J1: Argentina 2–0 Algeria is the most sensible prediction because Argentina have more control, experience and final-third quality, while Algeria’s best route depends on limited transition moments.
aiNotes.J2: Austria 2–0 Jordan is the most sensible prediction because Austria have a clearer tactical structure, stronger pressing game and more reliable chance creation, while Jordan’s scoring path depends on isolated transition moments.
aiNotes.K1: Portugal 2–0 DR Congo is the most sensible prediction because Portugal have superior midfield control, chance creation and bench depth, while DR Congo’s best route depends on rare transition moments.
aiNotes.L1: England 2–1 Croatia is the most sensible prediction because England have more depth, pace and late-game solutions, while Croatia’s midfield intelligence and set-piece threat make a clean win unlikely.
aiNotes.K2: Uzbekistan 1–2 Colombia is the most sensible prediction because Colombia have superior attacking quality and bench options, while Uzbekistan’s defensive discipline and set-piece threat make a clean win unlikely.
aiNotes.L2: Ghana 1–1 Panama is the most sensible prediction because Ghana have more open-play explosiveness, but Panama’s experience, set-piece route and Ghana’s injury-hit spine make a draw highly realistic.
